title: Round invoice totals once per invoice
problem:
Invoice totals round each line, so an invoice of three lines can be 1 cent off.

Done when `InvoiceTotalsTest` has a case with three lines of 0.335 and the total is 1.01.
plan:
1. Add `TaxRounding::perInvoice()` in `src/Billing/TaxRounding.php`.
2. Use it in `InvoiceTotals::total()`.
3. Test: a case with three lines of 0.335 in `tests/Billing/InvoiceTotalsTest.php`.

planApproval.reviewNote: The plan covers the rounding and its test. It leaves the shipping totals alone, which is right: BILL-9 owns them.
